resources.string: Connectivity controls that only work after you unlock. No network access, nothing leaves the device.
Grant Do Not Disturb access to toggle it from here.
Grant phone access to show mobile data status. Toggling works without it.
Wi-Fi, mobile data, location, airplane mode and DND, usable only when unlocked.
Pull down Quick Settings, tap the pencil, and drag Internet, Airplane mode, Location and Do Not Disturb out of the panel.
Puts the five controls on your home screen, which is behind the lock.
Lets the DND button toggle directly instead of opening settings.
Enable Theft Detection Lock and Offline Device Lock under Security, Theft protection.
Make sure Gemini/Assistant cannot change these settings from the lock screen.
Updates can restore removed Quick Settings tiles. Check the tile layout again.
